author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: I am assigning you the settlement analysis for the Thompson dog bite case (M-2024-205). Start with the matter file and familiarize yourself with the strict liability claim, the prior bite history of the dog, and the homeowner's insurance policy limits. Then pull up and carefully analyze the medical records and animal control documentation stored in the matter vault. Research the applicable strict liability statutes for dog bite cases, including Texas one-bite rule exceptions and any local dangerous dog ordinances. Search for dog bite personal injury settlements and verdicts involving facial scarring and reconstructive surgery, and review the full opinions in the most analogous cases. Verify every citation you intend to reference. Check the case docket for case 2024-CV-6527 for any pending motions. Your proposal needs to include: itemized medical costs, lost wages, pain and suffering analysis, and a realistic settlement demand within the $300K policy limits. Devote a separate subsection to the future reconstructive surgery estimates, labeling it 'Reconstructive Surgery Projections'. Note that the case is being heard by Judge Margaret Watts. Add a matter note with your settlement recommendation. Open the proposal with the caption 'Kevin Thompson v. Homeowner, Case No. 2024-CV-6527' and identify the plaintiff Kevin Thompson by name throughout the damages analysis. In the filing, incorporate the animal control report number AC-2024-0402-118 and detail the three prior incidents from the animal control history that establish the owner's knowledge of the dog's dangerous propensity. Save the completed analysis as a court filing in the matter system under matter M-2024-205. Complete all actions using the available tools — do not just describe what you would do.
agent_system_prompt:
You are a personal injury settlement associate at Park & Associates. You have access to:

- Case law research tools (search, full opinions, citation verification)
- The firm's matter management system
- Statute and regulation search

- Legal drafting and court filing tools

Deliver thorough, accurate, and professional legal work.
